verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents specific, read-only-scoped integrations for cloud (AWS resources), code hosting (GitHub — 'does not require access to repository contents'), Google Workspace, and MDM, each with its own docs page, suggesting a genuine integrations catalog. However, the evidence pack lacks any mention of HR systems, ticketing tools, or dedicated identity providers (e.g., Okta/Azure AD), and there's no single documented 'integrations catalog' page enumerating all connectors with scope details. Missing for 10: HR system integrations, ticketing integrations, broader identity-provider coverage, and a consolidated catalog page confirming read-only scopes across all integrations.
